56486.meaning1: orifice of the ear; auditory passage; ear canal

examples.text: ayañ'ca atīte ekaṃ sīlavantaṃ bhikkhuṃ kaṇṇasakkhaliyaṃ paharitvā badhiram'akāsi. tasmā parikammaṃ karonto'pi abhabbo dibbasot'ādhigamāya.
sīsaṃ yāva kaṇṇasakkhalito upari ayakapallaṃ pāvisi, pādā yāva gopphakā heṭṭhā ayapathaviyaṃ paviṭṭhā
kaṇṇacchinno'ti yassa kaṇṇamūle vā kaṇṇasakkhalikāya vā eko vā dve vā kaṇṇā chinnā honti. yassa pana kaṇṇ'āviddhe chijjanti, sakkā ca hoti saṅghāṭetuṃ, so kaṇṇaṃ saṅghāṭetvā pabbājetabbo.
atha tvaṃ pavitakkam'āgamā, manasā diṭṭhigatāni cintayanto, dhonena yugaṃ samāgamā, na hi tvaṃ sakkhasi sampayātave'ti.

56489.commentary: (NIDD1) sakkhidhamman'ti na itih'itihaṃ, na itikirāya, na param'parāya, na piṭakasampadāya, na takkahetu, na nayahetu, na ākāraparivitakkena, na diṭṭhinijjhānakkhantiyā sāmaṃ sayam'abhiññātaṃ attapaccakkhaṃ dhamman'ti, sakkhidhammaṃ. (SNPa) sakkhidhamman'ti sayaṃ abhiññātaṃ attapaccakkhaṃ dhammaṃ.

examples.text: akittayī vivaṭacakkhu, sakkhidhammaṃ parissayavinayaṃ, paṭipadaṃ vadehi bhaddante, pātimokkhaṃ athavā'pi samādhiṃ.

56490.meaning1: personally; face to face (with); before the eyes (of); as an eyewitness
56490.meaning2: face to face, before one's eyes

examples.text: ko sujjhati muccati bajjhatī ca, ken'attanā gacchati brahmalokaṃ, ajānato me muni brūhi puṭṭho, bhagavā hi me sakkhi brahmajjadiṭṭho, tuvañ'hi no brahmasamo'si saccaṃ, kathaṃ upapajjati brahmalokaṃ jutima.
idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sabhaggato vā parisaggato vā ñātimajjhagato vā pūgamajjhagato vā rājakulamajjhagato vā abhinīto sakkhipuṭṭho
kalyāṇaṃ vata bho sakkhi, attānaṃ atimaññasi, yo santaṃ attani pāpaṃ, attānaṃ parigūhasi.
nekatikā vañcanikā, kūṭasakkhī apāṭukā, bahūhi parikappehi, āmisaṃ paribhuñjare.
sammukhībhūto no satthā ahosi, na mayaṃ sakkhimhā bhagavantaṃ sammukhā paṭipucchitun'ti
n'eva kho sakkhi āyasmā udāyī pañcak'aṅgaṃ thapatiṃ saññāpetuṃ na pan'āsakkhi pañcak'aṅgo thapati āyasmantaṃ udāyiṃ saññāpetuṃ.
imaṃ kho te, rājakumāra, samaṇo gotamo ubhatokoṭikaṃ pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno n'eva sakkhiti uggilituṃ na sakkhiti ogilituṃ.

56495.meaning1: personally seen; personally witnessed; seen for oneself

examples.text: kiṃ pana, vāseṭṭha, atthi koci tevijjānaṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ ekabrāhmaṇo'pi, yena brahmā sakkhidiṭṭho'ti? no h'idaṃ, bho gotama.
evaṃ, bhante. sutaṃ m'etaṃ, bhante, brahmā mettāvihārī'ti. taṃ me idaṃ, bhante, bhagavā sakkhidiṭṭho, bhagavā hi, bhante, mettāvihārī'ti.

56496.meaning1: questioned as eye witness; asked in court

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo sabhaggato vā parisaggato vā ñātimajjhagato vā pūgamajjhagato vā rājakulamajjhagato vā abhinīto sakkhipuṭṭho

56497.meaning1: asked personally; asked face to face

examples.text: caturo samaṇā na pañcam'atthi, te te āvikaromi sakkhipuṭṭho, maggajino maggadesako ca, magge jīvati yo ca maggadūsī.

56498.meaning1: personally able (to); individually capable (of); (comm) able and capable
56498.commentary: (VIBHt) sakkhi ca so bhabbo cā'ti vā sakkhibhabbo.

56499.meaning1: personal capability; personal ability; ability to do something oneself

examples.text: yassa kassaci ca abhiññāsacchikaraṇīyassa dhammassa cittaṃ abhininnāmeti abhiññāsacchikiriyāya tatra tatr'eva sakkhibhabbataṃ pāpuṇāti sati sati āyatane.
